newsitem.title: MEXICO: Alestra sets Mexico long-distance telephone rates.
newsitem.headline: Alestra sets Mexico long-distance telephone rates.

text.p: Alestra, a Mexican long-distance company owned by AT&T Corp and Mexican holding company Grupo Industrial Alfa S.A., on Tuesday released its tariff rates for commercial long-distance calls.
Wide-spread competition in the long distance market starts on January 1 in Mexico.
Alestra said that under its AT&T Socios Plus program, per-minute prices of long distance calls from Mexico to the United States would be:
- to South America, the Caribbean and parts of the Mediterranean, 13.10 pesos.
- to the rest of the world, 14.50 pesos.
Alestra said it would apply a rate of 1.90 pesos per minute for national calls, with discounts available.
